## Importing transcribed compass points and tree measurements

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
por_compass_df<-read_excel("C:/Users/showa/Documents/GitHub/Apiary_LRR/Poria_survey_70s.xlsx", sheet = "Poria_compass_points", range = "A1:AC83", col_names = TRUE)

#subset four compass points for testing including some with "C" and negative numbers
compass_test<-por_compass_df[c(1:4, 35:37),]

#first change "C" Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4 to "0"
compass_test$Y_1 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_1 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_1))
compass_test$Y_2 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_2 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_2))
compass_test$Y_3 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_3 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_3))
compass_test$Y_4 <- as.double(ifelse(compass_test$Y_4 == "C", "0", compass_test$Y_4))

#make sure xs, ys, azimuths, distances are dbl not chr
#glimpse(compass_test)
compass_test$X_1 <- as.double(compass_test$X_1)
compass_test$Y_1 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_1)
compass_test$Y_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_2)
compass_test$Dist_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_2)
compass_test$Azimuth_2 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_2)
compass_test$X_3 <- as.double(compass_test$X_3)
compass_test$Y_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_3)
compass_test$Dist_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_3)
compass_test$Azimuth_3 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_3)
compass_test$X_4 <- as.double(compass_test$X_4)
compass_test$Y_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Y_4)
compass_test$Dist_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Dist_4)
compass_test$Azimuth_4 <- as.double(compass_test$Azimuth_4)
#glimpse(compass_test)

#then convert chain grid to computer grid
compass_test$comp_X_1 <- (-(compass_test$X_1 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_2 <- (-(compass_test$X_2 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_3 <- (-(compass_test$X_3 /2))+17 
compass_test$comp_X_4 <- (-(compass_test$X_4 /2))+17 

compass_test$comp_Y_1 <- (compass_test$Y_1 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_2 <- (compass_test$Y_2 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_3 <- (compass_test$Y_3 + 10) /2
compass_test$comp_Y_4 <- (compass_test$Y_4 + 10) /2

#create a distance grid measured in feet, based on the computer grid
compass_test$ft_X_1 <- compass_test$comp_X_1 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_2 <- compass_test$comp_X_2 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_3 <- compass_test$comp_X_3 * 132
compass_test$ft_X_4 <- compass_test$comp_X_4 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_1 <- compass_test$comp_Y_1 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_2 <- compass_test$comp_Y_2 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_3 <- compass_test$comp_Y_3 * 132
compass_test$ft_Y_4 <- compass_test$comp_Y_4 * 132

#calculate slope-corrected distances if necessary
compass_test$Dist_1_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_1'), compass_test$Dist_1, compass_test$Dist_1*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_1' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_2_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_2'), compass_test$Dist_2, compass_test$Dist_2*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_2' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_3_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_3'), compass_test$Dist_3, compass_test$Dist_3*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_3' /100)))
compass_test$Dist_4_cor<- ifelse(is.na(compass_test$'%_4'), compass_test$Dist_4, compass_test$Dist_4*cos(atan(compass_test$'%_4' /100)))

#Calculate cartesian coordinates for compass stations relative to ft grid (convert compass station chain coords to ft grid)

#calculation cartesian coordinates for tree relative to compass stations

#see this post for converting bearing and distance (polar) to Cartesian coordinates

#https://www.r-bloggers.com/2007/10/convert-polar-coordinates-to-cartesian/

polar2cart<-function(x,y,dist,bearing,as.deg=FALSE){
  ## Translate Polar coordinates into Cartesian coordinates
  ## based on starting location, distance, and bearing
  ## as.deg indicates if the bearing is in degrees (T) or radians (F)
  
  if(as.deg){
    ##if bearing is in degrees, convert to radians
    bearing=bearing*pi/180
  }
  
  newx<-x+dist*sin(bearing)  ##X
  newy<-y+dist*cos(bearing)  ##Y
  return(list("x"=newx,"y"=newy))
}


##Example

oldloc=c(0,5) 
bearing=200 #degrees
dist=5

newloc<-polar2cart(oldloc[1],oldloc[2],dist,bearing,TRUE)
plot(oldloc[1],oldloc[2],xlim=c(-10,10),ylim=c(-10,10))
points(newloc$x,newloc$y,col="red")

#this may not be necessary
#convert Dist_1-4 from ft to grid units
#compass_test$comp_Dist_1 <- compass_test$Dist_1 /132
#repeat for 2-4
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
